texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.What specifically at Relay interests you: Relay sits at the intersection of my two decades: fintech infrastructure and small-business operations. I have spent 11 years running an incubator and software house (Platinum VC & Incubator) watching hundreds of founders struggle with exactly the money-operations problems Relay solves - cash-flow visibility, spend control, banking that works for the owner instead of against them. On the build side I have shipped financial infrastructure hands-on: crypto-exchange backends, market-maker engines, a lending and credit-scoring system at Everex in Singapore, and one of the first detailed frameworks for a government-issued stablecoin. I want to bring that combination - product ownership plus real empathy for the SMB operator - to a team where banking IS the product.
texts.How do you use AI in your professional o: Daily and structurally. My lab runs a production fleet of six machines operated by Claude agents: multi-machine consensus (claw-consensus, with published evals and a public FAILURE-MODES.md), a persistent memory layer, an AI-native CRM and 100+ automation routines - all built and operated in public across 110 GitHub repos. I am the non-engineer in the loop: I own problem framing, architecture decisions and evaluation, while AI agents implement. We published a measured reliability eval: 0/17 high-risk actions slipped past the human approval gate in recorded runs. Personally, the same fleet runs my knowledge base, calendar and outreach - I dogfood AI operations every day.
